game_mechanic: 2D side-scrolling platformer with physics-driven movement and interactive level mechanisms. Gravity: 980 px/s². Player uses CharacterBody2D with move_and_slide(). World mechanisms include: Sliding Door (translates 64 pixels along its local axis when interacted with, duration 0.4s, ease-out); Rotating Platform (CharacterBody2D set to rotation mode, angular velocity 45 deg/s, reversible by switch); Spring (Area2D detector that overrides player.velocity.y to -750 on body_entered, with 0.1s cooldown). Camera2D follows the player horizontally with smoothing enabled (smoothing_speed 5.0), zoom Vector2(1.0, 1.0). Collision layer 1 = world, layer 2 = player, layer 3 = interactables.
enemy_interaction: No enemies in this scene. All hazards are environmental (spikes, pits, moving platforms). On contact with a hazard Area2D, the player is reset to the last checkpoint position via a 'hurt' animation and a 0.5s input lock.
start_screen_instructions: Title: 'Untitled Platformer'. Subtitle: 'Press any key to start'. Controls panel shows: A/D or Left/Right to move, Space to jump, E to interact with mechanisms. Title font size 48, body font size 20, centered on a CanvasLayer. Pressing any key transitions to the Main scene.
character_abilities: Variable jump height: releasing Space before apex cuts upward velocity by 50%
Coyote time: 0.1 s after leaving a ledge
Interact range: 28 px in front of the player (Area2D), triggered with E
